required_before_work: Read all Markdown files under .ai_memory in full.
Read projectbrief.md first and activeContext.md second.
Check activeContext.md for open [WIP] or [REWORK] items.
Classify the task as L0/L1/L2/L3 before execution.
Use reduce-interruption mode: make conservative assumptions for non-critical decisions and continue unless a hard blocker exists.
Stop and ask for confirmation before high-risk work such as data, auth, public API, deploy, or irreversible changes.
Read the latest snapshot of any target file before editing.
After verified completion, commit and push source changes with a clear Chinese commit message when the repository, remote, and permissions are available.
Keep local backups under .archive/ and keep runtime artifacts ignored by Git.

file_roles.projectbrief.md: Project objective, scope, business success criteria, hard constraints, and high-risk boundaries.
file_roles.activeContext.md: Current task state, risk grading, lock, next action, blockers, and verification evidence.
file_roles.agentRules.md: AI behavior rules, task grading, editing discipline, completion protocol, and handoff contract.
file_roles.techContext.md: Stack, commands, environment assumptions, and runtime constraints.
file_roles.progress.md: Verified completed work, evidence summaries, residual risks, and compact milestone history.
